**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 17:40
- [USER] User inquired about major milestones and challenges faced by Reebok throughout its history.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok was founded in 1895 as a small UK-based company and transformed into a global brand in the 1980s.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Freestyle shoe, introduced in 1982, was the first athletic shoe designed specifically for women.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok became a household name during the aerobics boom of the 1980s, partly due to the success of the Freestyle shoe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the 1990s, Reebok faced increased competition from rival brands like Nike and Adidas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Adidas acquired Reebok in 2005, helping the brand expand its reach and resources.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok experienced a decline in sales in the early 2010s due to changing consumer preferences and increased competition.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok has focused on sustainability by creating products using eco-friendly materials and launching a "Cotton + Corn" line of sneakers made from plant-based materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The COVID-19 pandemic caused financial difficulties for Reebok, resulting in job losses and store closures.
- [USER] User recalled that Reebok shoes were popular in the 80s and asked if they still make popular shoes today.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok continues to create popular shoes today, diversifying their offerings beyond athletic footwear to include lifestyle shoes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular Reebok shoes include the Reebok Classic, the Pump, Zig Kinetica, and Nano.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok has collaborated with prominent figures in fashion and sports to create limited edition shoes.
- [USER] User expressed appreciation for Reebok's adaptation to changing times and popularity.
- [USER] User asked about the collaborations Reebok has done.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok has collaborated with Victoria Beckham, CrossFit, Cardi B, Pyer Moss, and Marvel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The collaboration with Victoria Beckham includes a line of women's athletic wear.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok is the official outfitter of CrossFit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cardi B created her own line of sneakers called the Club C Cardi.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The collaboration with Pyer Moss celebrates Black culture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reebok has created sneakers inspired by Marvel Comics characters, including Black Widow and Captain America.
